subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` on `/v1/chat/completions` suppress validation of non-agent request-body `model` values for OpenAI SDK compatibility, or should the documented agent-first `model` contract keep rejecting them?
rationale: Both outcomes are plausible: accepting header precedence improves SDK compatibility, while rejecting generic models preserves the current stable Gateway HTTP contract and the `x-openclaw-model` override boundary.

options.title: Adopt header precedence
options.body: When the header resolves to a configured agent, ignore a non-agent request `model` for chat completions, document the precedence, and add focused tests.

options.title: Keep agent-first model contract
options.body: Continue requiring `model` to be `openclaw` or an OpenClaw agent target, and close this as a documented integration constraint.

options.title: Broaden across compat endpoints
options.body: Apply the same chosen precedence consistently to chat completions, responses, and embeddings if maintainers want one OpenAI-compatible rule.

recommendation.title: Adopt header precedence
recommendation.body: When the header resolves to a configured agent, ignore a non-agent request `model` for chat completions, document the precedence, and add focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current agent-first Gateway HTTP contract and the related endpoint expansion.
